descriptionChirho: Masculine noun יֶרֶק denoting 'green vegetation, herbs, greenness' as a collective or abstract term. In Gen 1:30 יֶרֶק עֵשֶׂב 'green herb/plant' (food given to animals at creation); Gen 9:3 כְּיֶרֶק עֵשֶׂב 'as the green herb' (all living things given for food after the flood); Exod 10:15 no יֶרֶק 'green thing' remained after the locust plague; Num 22:4 יֶרֶק הַשָּׂדֶה 'the green of the field' (what Israel consumed like an ox); Ps 37:2 וּכְיֶרֶק 'and like the green' (the wicked fade like grass); Isa 15:6 יֶרֶק 'green thing' (all vegetation withered in Moab's judgment). Consistently glossed as خُضْرَة (arb), Grüne/grün (deu), vert (fra), verde/verdor (spa), हरा/हरियाली (hin), 푸른 것 (kor). All occurrences share the same basic semantic domain of green vegetation.
